LanguageData.NR_DefenseIsolated: The network is isolated: no attacks get through, and nothing networked works.
LanguageData.NR_DefenseUpkeepShort: Not enough cyberdata for this ICE tier.
LanguageData.NR_DefenseUpkeepLost: The colony could not pay its ICE upkeep this season (or no longer has the research). The hub is back to bare firewalls.
LanguageData.NR_IceTierGizmoDesc: The colony's own ICE on top of the firewalls: Firewall +1 (network security), ICE +2 (active ICE), Black ICE +3 (black ICE defense). Each tier costs cyberdata every season; black ICE also adds a little Heat for every attack it burns.
LanguageData.NR_HoneypotGizmoDesc: This firewall lets attackers in on purpose: it adds no defense, but every attack the hub repels leaves a back-trace: 2-4 cyberdata or a hidden node revealed. One honeypot per colony.
LanguageData.NR_HoneypotActive: Honeypot mode: this firewall adds no defense and traces attackers back.
LanguageData.NR_HoneypotReveal: The honeypot traced the attacker back: node {0} is revealed.
LanguageData.NR_HoneypotLoot: The honeypot traced the attacker back: {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_IsolationGizmoDesc: Cut the colony off the net entirely. No network attacks get through, but the Gateway, dives, contracts, AI services and fixer calls stop, and awake AIs lose trust as if their server were isolated. They also stop making network noise.
LanguageData.NR_IsolationOn: The colony is cut off the net.
LanguageData.NR_IsolationOff: The colony is back on the net.
LanguageData.NR_DutyGizmoDesc: The netrunner in this pod guards the colony's hub: +1 hub defense for every {0} Intellectual.
LanguageData.NR_DefensePanelNone: No defense yet: build a firewall, set ICE, put a guard on duty.
LanguageData.NR_DefensePanelNoFirewall: No powered firewall. ICE needs at least one.
LanguageData.NR_DefensePanelIntrusions: Intrusions on their way to Home: {0}. A runner can meet them on the map.
LanguageData.NR_IsolationCooldown: The ports are cooling down after the last isolation: {0} left.
LanguageData.NR_IsolationShort: The network came back too soon after isolation: the reconnect lit up the trace (+{0} Heat) and jolted the netrunners in pods.
